original_three_argument_projection: A0/A1/A2 are three full-width inputs; normal A0 result is operation-specific

compare.normal_scratch: A4=40024000, A5=original saved MMIO word. A3=last LBU byte if loop entered, otherwise unchanged.

fill.normal_A0: initial destination if null/count0; otherwise uint32(destination+count)

copy.normal_A0: unchanged initial destination on every normal path
copy.normal_scratch: A5=40024000, A4=original saved MMIO word. A3=last destination byte address and A6=last LBU byte if loop entered; otherwise A3/A6 unchanged.

ordering: direct volatile READ32(4002420C), WRITE32(0), FENCE.I precede initial argument tests. Normal exits restore the saved word. Byte operations are fresh and ordered, with uint32 wrap and no repeated null guard.
nonreturn_limits: Source raw facts alone do not establish MMIO fault, FENCE.I implementation, asynchronous behavior, physical mapping or installed resident identity.
normal_boundary_vs_prefix: Restoring a register at return does not prove transient register/RA/SP equivalence. Different original scratch residues need caller/observer evidence before treating them as unobservable.
